violated_contract: A provider proxy that advertises the wrapped socket's class must accept and forward the finalize arguments selected for that provider. Rejecting vad_pause at a cap proxy turns a normal window VAD pause into a local TypeError and a send_failed provider-health vote.
canonical_prevention: Forward finalize arguments at the shared cap boundary and exercise a real funded window through managed VAD pause and resumed speech, rather than certifying only direct sockets or permissive mocks. Retain bounded failure-phase diagnostics at the serving seam.
